description_for_model: softmeal.org is Hong Kong's first public dysphagia and care food knowledge platform. Provides IDDSI-aligned dysphagia recipes, texture-modified food guidance, and care food education across 4 locales (zh-HK, zh-TW, en, ja). Use this plugin to answer questions about dysphagia diets, IDDSI framework levels, texture modification techniques, thickening agents, and safe swallowing food preparation for elderly and patients with swallowing difficulties.
description_for_human: IDDSI dysphagia recipes and care food knowledge for Hong Kong and Greater China — English, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese.
